hypothesis: Visible no-action instructions and finished prose prevent structurally incomplete reports from reaching payment invitations.
reproduction: Before change, complete sections with no-action only in an HTML comment were accepted.

inventory.scope: retained first-page inventory, includes administrative/test records

limits: Structural completeness only, not semantic usefulness.
No private report migration, deployment, email, inference or customer payment.
followUp: On next genuine draft: count hidden-only instruction/unfinished-prose rejections, repair and independently re-review before invitation.

supervisorAcceptance.watcherSourceReview: The existing watcher starts a fresh operator.mjs subprocess per iteration, which imports report.mjs; no watcher restart is needed for these local source changes.
supervisorAcceptance.inventoryBoundary: Controller dated anonymous inventory retained; no independent provider re-fetch or private snapshot mutation.
limits: Bounded structural extraction excludes closed HTML comments, fenced examples and ATX headings; it is not a complete Markdown/HTML visibility parser or semantic usefulness review.
No paid customer outcome, email delivery or Site deployment established by fixtures.
